summary: Halifax County, NC, fire tower site near Medoc; the only dated record is an October 1947 county decision to cooperate on a third tower. No source describes it afterward.

notes_for_editor: The only tower-specific item is the October 16, 1947 county decision quoted by Forest Lookouts from the Roanoke Rapids Herald. It is a decision to cooperate on a tower near Medoc, not a record that one was built. Two web searches and reads of Medoc Mountain State Park histories (Wikipedia, NCpedia) found no tower; do not mix the park up with the tower site, and the park's history does not say where the 1947 tower would have stood. The record's NGS register entry (state number FX 4254 in tnlandforms) was not checked against any NGS source and was not used. Suggested checks: NCFS Halifax County office, and North Carolina State Archives for the 1947 county minutes and any later record of construction or removal. The record's height, design and status remain unknown.
